WITH [x IN nodes(path) WHERE any(l IN labels(x) WHERE l IN ['Equipment','PipingComponent']) | x] AS items
UNWIND items AS item
RETURN
  item.tag AS tag,
  coalesce(item.piping_component_name, '') AS name,
  labels(item) AS labels
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN item:CentrifugalPump OR item:Compressor OR item:ProcessColumn OR item:PressureVessel OR item:ProcessInstrumentationFunction THEN 0
    WHEN item:CheckValve OR item:BallValve OR item:GlobeValve OR item:OperatedValve THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END, tag
